tldr: Lilith in the 1st house: your raw, untamed self shows openly
body: Lilith in the 1st house: your raw, untamed self shows openly. Where you refuse to be tamed and reclaim your right to take up space. Watch: defiance that pushes people away. You are uncompromising about who you are; you refuse to be told how to be, and it shows on sight. Strongly colors the whole personality; intense drives that often sit hidden in the unconscious. The work is to understand and own the energy rather than be unconsciously run by it.
business: A magnetic, undeniable presence when owned.
shadow: A confrontational identity, or hiding the raw self behind a guarded front.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
